description: Poll or close an already purchased Oracle Watch window using its one-time oww_ token. Poll returns a fresh signal at zero extra credits; close returns the complete window summary and the final signal. Use it only with a window token from oracle_watch_window_begin. Do not use it for a one-off snapshot (oracle_watch) and never reuse a token after close. Returns the signal (poll) or the combined summary (close).

op.description: poll issues a signal; close returns the summary

window_token.description: One-time oww_ token from the purchase

name: oracle_watch_window_control
